name: gap_momentum_continuation
author: claude_strategist
mechanism: When NIFTY gaps >0.3% at the open due to overnight global cues (SGX Nifty, US futures, Asia markets), institutional desks carry a directional bias established before the bell. The first 15 minutes (09:15-09:30) acts as a price-discovery absorption window where algos benchmark against overnight gamma. When price breaks above the 15-minute opening range high on a bullish gap (or below the range low on a bearish gap) accompanied by a volume surge, it signals that resting institutional buy (or sell) interest has overwhelmed the supply ceiling, and TWAP/VWAP algorithms begin chasing fills — creating a 30-90 second momentum continuation window. At 5-second resolution, we can enter at the breakout bar itself rather than waiting for a full minute confirmation, capturing the first 15-20 NIFTY spot points of institutional flow.

indicators.name: gap_pct
indicators.purpose: Daily scalar measuring the overnight gap. Same as original — gap is a day-level measure computed from previous close to current open, requiring only 1 prior bar. The 0.3% threshold is calibrated for index (not stock): NIFTY gaps >0.3% roughly 2-3 times per week based on meaningful global cue divergence; the original's 2% is stock-specific (earnings) and would be near-never on NIFTY.

indicators.name: orb_high_180
indicators.formula: max(high) for bars where time_min in [555, 569]
indicators.purpose: Opening range high over first 15 minutes (09:15-09:30 = 180 bars at 5s). NOT scaled from original — the time window is the same 15 minutes regardless of bar size. This is a FIXED TIME WINDOW (see Lookback Framework rule 1). The 15-min window is the standard institutional absorption period on NSE.

indicators.name: orb_low_180
indicators.formula: min(low) for bars where time_min in [555, 569]
indicators.purpose: Opening range low. Same fixed-window rationale as orb_high_180. Together these define the range that institutions have absorbed the gap information within.

indicators.name: vol_rel_240
indicators.purpose: Relative volume: current 5s bar volume vs 20-min rolling average (240 bars = same 20-min duration as original's sma(volume, 20) on 1-min bars). A surge >1.5x at the breakout bar confirms that the move is order-flow driven (not a thin-market spike). Original used the same 1.5x multiplier; kept because the threshold tests the same economic condition — outsized participation at the breakout moment.

conditions: time_minutes >= 570 (09:30 IST, after ORB window closes)
time_minutes < 690 (11:30 IST, before gap momentum fades)
close crosses above orb_high_180 (first cross only — prev bar was below)
buy_ce.confirmation: First-cross filter: previous bar must be at or below ORB high to avoid chasing re-entries on stale breakouts

conditions: close crosses below orb_low_180 (first cross only — prev bar was above)
buy_pe.confirmation: First-cross filter: previous bar must be at or above ORB low

exit.stop_rationale: 5 option pts corresponds to ~10 NIFTY spot pts adverse move from breakout. If the ORB breakout reverses 10 spot pts, price has re-entered the opening range and the institutional continuation thesis is invalidated; typical 30-60s adverse moves post-false-breakout are 8-12 spot pts (4-6 option pts), so 5 pts gives a small buffer above the false-signal noise floor.
exit.target_rationale: 8 option pts ≈ 16 NIFTY spot pts at delta ~0.5. On a genuine gap + ORB breakout day, the first continuation leg typically extends 15-25 spot pts within 60-90 seconds as TWAP algorithms chase fills; 8 pts captures the lower bound of this range with a 1:1.6 risk-reward ratio.

filters.vix_filter: none — gap momentum works across VIX regimes on index; high VIX = larger moves which helps this strategy
filters.time_filter: 09:30-11:30 IST only — gap momentum fades by noon as institutional orders complete, mean reversion dominates afternoon
filters.trend_filter: gap direction must match breakout direction (bullish gap + upside ORB break, bearish gap + downside ORB break)

edge.edge_decay_risk: low-medium — structural (gap + institutional flow), but NIFTY gap frequency depends on global macro volatility regimes

adaptation_notes: Three major changes from original: (1) Gap threshold dropped from 2% to 0.3% — stock earnings can gap 5-10%, NIFTY rarely gaps >1% so 0.3% captures the tail of meaningful global-cue-driven gaps without being too selective. (2) Universe changed from nifty200 stocks to NIFTY index — stock-specific gap triggers (earnings, orders) replaced by index-level overnight global cue gaps. The mechanism is the same (institutional bias + ORB confirmation) but the driver changes from fundamentals to macro flows. (3) First-cross filter added (not in original) — at 5s resolution a breakout lasts multiple bars, so we only enter on the actual crossover bar to avoid chasing. Original's 1-min bars naturally provided this by construction. Exit changed from VWAP cross to time_stop (90s) since we are capturing a short momentum burst, not a multi-hour trend.
weaknesses: On days with shallow gaps (0.3-0.5%), the ORB breakout may be a false signal and price reverts quickly — first-cross + volume filter mitigates but does not eliminate
NIFTY gaps >0.3% occur roughly 2-3 times per week, so trade frequency is low (1-4/day on gap days, 0 on non-gap days)
If global cues reverse mid-morning (e.g., US futures flip), gap direction bias becomes stale — hard to detect at 5s
ORB computed on noisy 5s bars — a spike in first 15 min can set a spuriously high range, causing no breakout signal even on strong gap days
